title: kaizen plugin-development intake checklist
description: Data-driven QA checklist mapping plugin-development work-types to the skills that should be Skill-loaded before writing code. Consumed by skills/plugin-development/scripts/intake.py + /kaizen:plugin-development intake [<work-type>]. First-match-wins by id → id-substring → trigger-substring → generic-plugin-work fallback.

always.description: Skills that apply to EVERY plugin-development task. Added on top of any work-type-specific bundle.

id.description: Kebab-case id, unique. The /kaizen:plugin-development intake <id> form resolves to this.

triggers.description: Substring phrases. Empty array = fallback bucket (matched only when explicit id is given).

skills.description: Skills to add on top of `always:` for this work-type. May be empty (generic-plugin-work fallback).

skill_ref.description: Plugin-namespaced skill ref — `<plugin>:<skill>` or `<plugin>:<parent>:<sub>` (e.g. plugin:plugin-development, plugin:coding-skills:kiss).
